name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 (pose)
description: Text-to-image with Stable Diffusion 1.5, posed like the person in a picture. The pose is read off the picture as a skeleton, and an OpenPose ControlNet holds the result to it while the prompt decides everything else: who, wearing what, where. The result takes the picture's shape.

params.label: Pose
params.description: A photo of someone in the pose you want, or — with "Detect the pose" off — a ready OpenPose skeleton. Its shape sets the size.

params.label: Detect the pose
params.description: Find the pose in the picture with SDPose and draw it as a skeleton. Turn it off when the picture already is a skeleton (coloured limbs on black).

params.label: Pose strength
params.description: How hard the ControlNet holds the result to the skeleton. Lower it if the pose comes out stiff or the picture breaks up; raise it if the pose is ignored.

params.label: Size
params.description: How many pixels the result has, in megapixels; its shape is the pose picture's. 0.25 is SD 1.5's own 512×512, and much past it the model starts repeating limbs.

params.label: Pose from
params.description: Where in the schedule the ControlNet starts steering. Above 0 lets the model lay the picture out freely first.

params.label: Pose until
params.description: Where it stops. Below 1 leaves the last, fine-detail steps to the model alone.

params.label: ControlNet
params.description: An SD 1.5 OpenPose ControlNet, in `controlnet/`. A ControlNet for another family will not load.
